plan.title: Partial award to Vendor B with approval refusal

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids in Master QCS.
Enable partial awarding required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects required by the case.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate only 6 of the 10 requested units to Vendor B.
Verify one of two vendors is awarded and the proposal value is 6 × 90 = 540.
Create the proposal from the partial allocation.
Verify the proposal identifies Vendor B.
Verify the proposal shows the partial award value.
Verify the proposal shows the awarded quantity.
Complete mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Verify the submitted proposal is pending approval before the approver action.
